title: Mock For All
summary: A student-run project that makes mock trial accessible to students across China. I lead 15+ peers across marketing and video, publishing tutorials and case breakdowns on Rednote, Douyin, Bilibili, Instagram, and YouTube.

title: Drones and the future of work
summary: A 5,000-word paper on automation at SF Express and Meituan, based on fieldwork at SF's drone testing site and interviews with technicians. The finding: drones help workers, but infrastructure policy lags. I also made a 10-minute documentary.

title: Divorce law in China
summary: A 4,000-word paper on how the Article 1077 cooling-off period endangers people facing domestic violence. I sent a reform proposal to the NPC Legislative Affairs Commission and built a resource site with hotlines for all 31 provinces.
